1.text: A Rank Stabilization Scaling Factor for Fine-Tuning with LoRA
1.zh: 一种用于 LoRA 微调的秩稳定缩放因子

1.text: As large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly compute and memory intensive, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are now a common strategy to fine-tune LLMs. A popular PEFT method is Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA), which adds trainable low-rank “adapters” to selected layers. Each adapter consists of a low-rank matrix product, multiplicatively scaled by a rank-dependent factor. This scaling factor, which divides adapters by a factor of the rank, results in slowed learning and stunted performance for LoRA with higher-rank adapters. Consequently, the use of LoRA in practice has generally been limited to very low ranks. In this work, we study the impact of the scaling factor on the learning process and prove that LoRA adapters should be divided by a factor of the square root of the rank. Modifying LoRA with the appropriate scaling factor, which we call the rank-stabilized LoRA (rsLoRA) method, easily provides for a fine-tuning compute/performance trade-off, where larger ranks can be used to trade off increased computational resources during training for better fine-tuning performance, with no
1.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）对计算和内存的消耗越来越大，参数高效微调（PEFT）已经成了微调 LLM 的常用策略。其中一种常用方法是低秩适配器（LoRA）：在选定的层上加上可训练的低秩“适配器”。每个适配器是一个低秩矩阵乘积，再乘上一个随秩变化的因子。这个缩放因子按秩去除适配器，于是秩一高，LoRA 就学得慢，性能也上不去。因此实践中 LoRA 通常只用很低的秩。本文研究这个缩放因子对学习过程的影响，并证明 LoRA 适配器应当按秩的平方根来除。用合适的缩放因子改过 LoRA 之后，我们把这种方法称为秩稳定 LoRA（rsLoRA）。它很容易给出微调时计算量与性能的权衡：可以用更大的秩，拿训练中多出来的计算资源去换更好的微调性能，而且没有

1.text: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable in the domain of natural language processing (Bommasani et al., 2021). They have been successful in a wide variety of applications ranging from machine translation (Zhu et al., 2023), disease prediction (Rasmy et al., 2021), generating code for robotics control policies (Liang et al., 2023), to chat-bot assistants (Ouyang et al., 2022). While their inherent generalization capability is impressive, performance on down-stream tasks often requires fine-tuning (Ding et al., 2022), which induces substantial computational resource requirements. To address these problems, a multitude of fine-tuning approaches have recently been introduced for computationally-efficient training (Houlsby et al., 2019; Hu et al., 2022; Zaken et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2022; Edalati et al., 2022; Hyeon-Woo et al., 2023; Ding et al., 2022). These methods seek to optimize a reduced set of parameters while achieving comparable performance to full model fine-tuning. Of particular relevance for this paper is the method of Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA), in which “adapters”, consisting of a low-rank matrix product multiplied by a scaling factor, are added to a subset of parameter
1.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）做自然语言处理的能力越来越强（Bommasani et al., 2021）。它们已经用在很多地方：机器翻译（Zhu et al., 2023）、疾病预测（Rasmy et al., 2021）、为机器人控制策略生成代码（Liang et al., 2023），以及聊天助手（Ouyang et al., 2022）。模型本身的泛化能力很强，但下游任务的表现往往还要靠微调（Ding et al., 2022），而微调会带来相当大的计算开销。为应对这些问题，近来出现了许多计算上更省的微调方法（Houlsby et al., 2019; Hu et al., 2022; Zaken et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2022; Edalati et al., 2022; Hyeon-Woo et al., 2023; Ding et al., 2022）。这些方法希望只优化较少的参数，同时达到与全模型微调相当的性能。和本文特别相关的是低秩适配器（LoRA）：其中的“适配器”由低秩矩阵乘积再乘一个缩放因子构成，被加到一部分参数

1.text: a factor of the square root of the rank, as opposed to conventional LoRA implementation in which adapters are divided by a factor of the rank. We call our method with this corrected scaling factor the rank-stabilized LoRA (rsLoRA) method. We experimentally verify the performance and learning stability of rsLoRA in comparison with the standard LoRA method. We illustrate that the conventional implementation causes gradient collapse as the rank increases, which slows the learning such that larger ranks perform no different than small ranks. In contrast, with rsLoRA the gradients do not collapse, and training with higher ranks increases performance. As such, the rsLoRA method easily provides for a fine-tuning compute/performance trade off, where higher ranks can be used to trade increased training compute for better performance. 2.text: We first provide an overview of the LoRA method and then follow with the introduction of a framework for studying scaling-initialization-update schemes used in (Yang & Hu, 2022), as our analysis follows a similar approach.
2.zh: 我们先概述 LoRA，再介绍（Yang & Hu, 2022）里用来研究缩放–初始化–更新方案的框架，因为我们的分析沿用了类似的做法。

2.text: In light of the hypothesis that fine-tuning of pre-trained LLM parameters takes place on a manifold with low intrinsic dimension (Aghajanyan et al., 2020; Li et al., 2018), the authors of (Houlsby et al., 2019) provide an alternative to full model fine-tuning, tuning far fewer parameters with comparable performance. They introduce the concept of fine-tuning an LLM by fixing all existing pre-trained model parameters while adding an “adapter” module after each pre-LayerNorm attention or feed-forward sub-module of the transformer. The adapters are composed of a two-layer neural network with a low hidden-layer dimension, such that learning is constrained to a parameter-efficient low-dimensional manifold.
2.zh: 预训练 LLM 的参数微调被认为发生在内在维度较低的流形上（Aghajanyan et al., 2020; Li et al., 2018）。基于这一假设，Houlsby et al.（2019）给出了全模型微调之外的一条路：只调节少得多的参数，性能与全模型微调相当。他们的做法是固定全部已有的预训练参数，并在 Transformer 每个 pre-LayerNorm 的注意力子模块或前馈子模块之后加入一个“适配器”模块。适配器由隐藏层维度很低的两层神经网络构成，学习因此被约束在一个参数高效的低维流形上。

2.text: The LoRA method modifies the form of the adapters to be computed in parallel with their associated transformer submodules, such that following fine-tuning, they can be combined with the pre-trained parameters for efficient inference.
2.zh: LoRA 改变了适配器的形式，让它与对应的 Transformer 子模块并行计算。微调之后，可以把适配器与预训练参数合并，推理仍然高效。

2.text: A follow-on method, AdaloRA (Zhang et al., 2023) allocates rank to LoRA adapters dynamically during training based on an available compute budget. It achieves this by parameterizing the adapter matrix product in an approximate SVD representation and iteratively prunes singular values (based on an importance score) to potentially reduce rank at each training step. Since AdaLoRA uses the same γr as LoRA, while seeking to dynamically allow the use of different rank adapters, optimizing the selection of γr, as proposed in this paper, can improve upon AdaLoRA. As will be shown, the setting of the scaling factor γr in LoRA is overly aggressive and causes gradient collapse as the rank increases, which slows the learning such that LoRA fine-tuning using larger ranks performs no different than that with very small ranks. This may have led the authors of (Hu et al., 2022) to inaccurately conclude that very low ranks (e.g. 4,8,16) “suffice” ((Hu et al., 2022) Table 6), since rank 64 showed no improvements in training with the same setting of α.
2.zh: 后续方法 AdaLoRA（Zhang et al., 2023）在训练中按可用计算预算，动态给 LoRA 适配器分配秩。它把适配器的矩阵乘积参数化成近似 SVD，并按重要性分数迭代剪去奇异值，从而有可能在每个训练步降低秩。AdaLoRA 使用与 LoRA 相同的 γr，同时又希望动态使用不同秩的适配器，因此按本文的方式来选取 γr，可以在 AdaLoRA 之上再改进。后文会说明，LoRA 里 γr 的设定过于激进，会随秩增大造成梯度坍缩，学习因此变慢，结果用较大秩做 LoRA 微调与用很小的秩没有差别。这或许使 Hu et al.（2022）的作者得出了不准确的结论：很低的秩（例如 4、8、16）就“够了”（Hu et al., 2022，表 6），因为在同样的 α 下，秩 64 的训练并没有提升。

4.text: A Rank Stabilization Scaling Factor for Fine-Tuning with LoRA
4.zh: 一种用于 LoRA 微调的秩稳定缩放因子

4.text: See appendix A for detailed proof. The above theorem suggests that the only way to ensure stability through the adapters for an arbitrary rank, is to scale the adapters with γr ∝ √1 . At first glance, it may appear that the assumptions made for the definition of rank-stabilized adapters are not straightforward, since for a layer in the middle of the model the gradient to the adapter should depend on r via adapters from later layers. Moreover, the activations should depend on r from adapters of earlier layers. However, since the input data to the model does not depend at all on the rank r of adapters, we can inductively apply the theorem from input layers to output layers with the forward propagation of activations. This results in an output loss gradient above the adapters which should not otherwise have reason to have magnitude unstable or collapsing in the limit of r. Following this gradient backpropagation, we can inductively apply the theorem in a similar fashion from output layers to input layers to pass through each adapter while maintaining the gradient magnitude in Θr(1). We would like to point out that theorem 3.2 pertains to the stability or collapse of the learning process in the limiting case of r, and does not make any statements about possible variations in performance of features learned with different ranks when learning is stable. The quality of the features during learning can also affect the magnitude of the gradient. This suggests that if the quality of features learned consistently depends on r, the assumptions of the theorem may not hold. Conversely, if the quality of learning is independent of rank, there would be no reason to use larger ranks given the increased resources required. Therefore, the extent to which these factors interplay, the implications of the theorem in practice, and potential benefits of using the corrected scaling factor, require experimental validation and examination.
4.zh: 详细证明见附录 A。上述定理说明，要对任意秩都让适配器保持稳定，只能按 γr ∝ √1 来缩放适配器。乍看之下，秩稳定适配器定义里的假设并不好直接用：对位于模型中间的一层，适配器上的梯度会经由后面各层的适配器依赖于 r，激活也会经由前面各层的适配器依赖于 r。不过，模型的输入数据完全不依赖于适配器的秩 r，因此可以顺着激活的前向传播，从输入层到输出层归纳地使用该定理。这样得到的、位于适配器之上的输出损失梯度，在 r 的极限下并没有别的理由在幅度上不稳定或坍缩。再沿着这条梯度做反向传播，可以用同样的方式从输出层到输入层归纳地使用该定理，在穿过每一个适配器时把梯度幅度保持在 Θr(1)。需要指出，定理 3.2 说的是 r 趋于极限时学习过程的稳定或坍缩，并没有谈论：当学习保持稳定时，不同秩学到的特征在性能上可能有什么差别。学习过程中特征的质量也会影响梯度幅度。因此，如果学到的特征质量始终依赖于 r，定理的假设就可能不成立。反过来，如果学习质量与秩无关，那么既然更大的秩要更多资源，就没有理由使用更大的秩。这些因素如何交织、定理在实践中意味着什么，以及使用修正后的缩放因子有什么好处，都需要实验来验证和考察。

4.text: To carry out our experiments with LoRA and rsLoRA, we choose a popular model and fine-tuning dataset: We fine-tune the Llama 2 model (Touvron et al., 2023) on 20,000 examples of the OpenOrca instruction tuning dataset (Mukherjee et al., 2023), using the AdamW optimizer (Loshchilov & Hutter, 2019) with the HuggingFace default learning rate of .00005 on a constant learning rate schedule. We add and optimize adapters in all linear (i.e., non-LayerNorm) attention and feed-forward MLP sub-modules of the transformer, since this has been shown to perform best with LoRA for a given parameter number budget ((Zhang et al., 2023) Appendix F). 5.text: A Rank Stabilization Scaling Factor for Fine-Tuning with LoRA
5.zh: 一种用于 LoRA 微调的秩稳定缩放因子

5.text: average parameter gradient norm (Figure 3). The study (Ding et al., 2022) asserts that fine-tuning on an increased number of parameters tends to perform better, with full-model fine-tuning consistently outperforming parameter efficient methods. Therefore we have reason to conjecture that training with larger ranks should outperform training with smaller ranks. Indeed, as illustrated in figure 2, we find that rsLoRA unlocks this performance increase for larger ranks, while LoRA’s overly aggressive scaling factor collapses and slows learning with larger ranks such that there is little to no performance difference when compared to low ranks. Validating our predictions, we illustrate in figure 3 that LoRA has collapsing gradients with higher ranks, whereas rsLoRA maintains the same gradient norm for each rank at the onset of training, while the norms remain approximately within the same order of magnitude throughout the training process.
5.zh: 平均参数梯度范数（图 3）。Ding et al.（2022）认为，参与微调的参数越多，效果往往越好，全模型微调一直优于参数高效方法。因此我们有理由猜想，用更大的秩训练应当优于用更小的秩。图 2 确实表明，rsLoRA 把更大秩带来的性能提升释放了出来；LoRA 过于激进的缩放因子则在较大秩下让学习坍缩并变慢，结果和低秩相比几乎没有性能差别。与我们的预测相符，图 3 显示 LoRA 在更高秩下梯度坍缩，而 rsLoRA 在训练一开始让每个秩的梯度范数相同，并且整个训练过程中这些范数大致保持在同一个数量级。

5.text: Figure 3. Gradient norm for varying rank. To evaluate learning stability, we vary ranks r ∈ {4, 8, 32, 128, 512, 2048} and compare the average parameter gradient norm of LoRA and rsLoRA, where higher ranks are line-plotted brighter in color. In the copper color gradient, LoRA has collapsing gradients with higher rank. In the blue to green color gradient, rsLoRA has the same gradient norm for each rank at the onset of training, while the norms remain approximately within the same order of magnitude throughout training.
5.zh: 图 3. 不同秩下的梯度范数。为评估学习稳定性，我们取秩 r ∈ {4, 8, 32, 128, 512, 2048}，比较 LoRA 和 rsLoRA 的平均参数梯度范数，秩越高，折线颜色越亮。在铜色渐变中，LoRA 在更高秩下出现梯度坍缩。在蓝到绿的颜色渐变中，rsLoRA 在训练开始时各个秩的梯度范数相同，并且整个训练过程中范数大致保持在同一个数量级。

5.text: To account for other potential variables, we run an extensive set of ablations, some of which we enumerate here (see appendix section B for all ablations and details):
5.zh: 为排除其他可能的变量，我们做了一组比较全面的消融，这里列出其中一部分（全部消融和细节见附录 B）：

5.text: • We repeat the experiment with a different pre-trained model, dataset and optimizer, and observe the same pattern of
5.zh: • 换一个预训练模型、数据集和优化器重复该实验，观察到同样的模式

5.text: • We observe the same pattern of stability in gradient norms with SGD, to control for any additional stabilization effects that may have been caused by AdamW or other adaptive optimizers used in practice.
5.zh: • 用 SGD 时，梯度范数也呈现同样的稳定模式。这是为了控制 AdamW 或其他实践中常用的自适应优化器可能额外带来的稳定作用。

5.text: • We sweep through learning rates for LoRA with rank 4, and get that performance cannot match that of rsLoRA with high rank with the default learning rate, showing that the increased capacity is a requirement for improved learning, and the larger γr of rsLoRA is not just acting as a learning rate boost.
5.zh: • 我们对秩为 4 的 LoRA 扫描学习率，得到的性能仍然比不上使用默认学习率的高秩 rsLoRA。这说明要学得更好，增加容量是必要条件；rsLoRA 里更大的 γr 并不只是在放大学习率。

5.text: • Using adapters in just the attention modules, which is commonly used with LoRA, gives similar results.
5.zh: • 只在注意力模块里使用适配器（这是 LoRA 的常见用法），结果类似。

5.text: • If instead of reparameterizing the adapters with a scaling factor we only rank-correct the initialization of the adapter, we observe that learning becomes unstable during training for larger ranks.
5.zh: • 如果不用缩放因子重新参数化适配器，而只对适配器的初始化做秩校正，我们观察到更大的秩在训练过程中会变得不稳定。

5.text: In this paper we theoretically derived a rank correcting factor for scaling additive adapters when fine-tuning, and experimentally validated the approach. We showed that, in direct contrast to LoRA, learning with the proposed rank-stabilized adapters method remains stable and non-collapsing even for very large adapter ranks, allowing one to achieve better performance using larger ranks. This allows for unrestricted parameter efficiency, where one can use the maximum rank possible given an
5.zh: 本文从理论上推导了微调时用于缩放加性适配器的秩校正因子，并用实验验证了这一做法。我们表明，与 LoRA 直接相反：使用所提出的秩稳定适配器时，即使适配器秩非常大，学习仍然稳定、不会坍缩，因此可以用更大的秩取得更好的性能。这使得参数效率不受限制：可以在给定的

6.text: A Rank Stabilization Scaling Factor for Fine-Tuning with LoRA
6.zh: 一种用于 LoRA 微调的秩稳定缩放因子

6.text: available memory budget to obtain the best fine-tuning performance. Our findings motivate further studies into the effects of the learning manifold intrinsic dimensionality in the context of fine tuning, since the implications of the original LoRA work inaccurately suggests and purveys the idea that very low ranks suffice when aiming to maximize fine-tuning performance. Possible avenues for future work include investigation of the proposed correction factor’s use in the AdaLoRA method (Zhang et al., 2023), which currently employs the same scaling factor for adapters as in conventional LoRA. Since any adapter is free to potentially be of full rank, the method may be more useful when built on rsLoRA instead of LoRA. Based on our results, we conjecture that AdaLoRA with rsLoRA should see increased fine-tuning performance, with substantial improvements in the case of higher rank budgets.
6.zh: 可用内存预算下使用尽可能大的秩，以取得最好的微调性能。这些结果促使进一步研究微调场景里学习流形的内在维度有什么影响，因为原始 LoRA 工作的含义并不准确，它暗示并传播了这样一种看法：若要把微调性能做到最好，很低的秩就够了。今后可以考察所提出的校正因子用在 AdaLoRA（Zhang et al., 2023）中的效果；AdaLoRA 目前对适配器使用的缩放因子与常规 LoRA 相同。任何适配器都可能取到满秩，因此这个方法建立在 rsLoRA 上，而不是 LoRA 上，可能会更有用。基于我们的结果，我们猜想 AdaLoRA 与 rsLoRA 一起使用时微调性能会提高，秩预算较高时改进会相当明显。

9.text: Figure 4. Gradient norm for varying rank with SGD. 9.text: To show the generality of the results, we re-run training with a different model, optimizer, and fine-tuning dataset. We train the 6 billion parameter GPT-J (Wang & Komatsuzaki, 2021) on the GSM8k benchmark dataset, which consists of grade school math word problems (Cobbe et al., 2021). We use the adaptive optimizer Adafactor (Shazeer & Stern, 2018). The results plotted below show that our findings do indeed translate to this completely different setting.
9.zh: 为说明这些结果是否普遍，我们换了模型、优化器和微调数据集重新训练。我们在 GSM8k 基准上训练 60 亿参数的 GPT-J（Wang & Komatsuzaki, 2021）。GSM8k 由小学数学应用题组成（Cobbe et al., 2021）。优化器使用自适应方法 Adafactor（Shazeer & Stern, 2018）。下面的结果表明，我们的发现在这个完全不同的设定里同样成立。

10.text: Here we examine training performance where instead of reparameterizing the adapters with a scaling factor, we only rank-correct the initialization of the adapter. We examine this in two ways by looking at rank 4 and 2048: First we do not use any scaling factor at all and just scale the initialization of the matrix A by √1 . With this, although the gradient norms are the same magnitude at initialization for rank 4 and 2048, we observed that training perplexity becomes unstable during training for rank 2048. Secondly, we scale the initialization of the matrix A by √1 but also use the LoRA scaling factor of 1 to scale adapters. This shows the same sub-optimal training as with LoRA, and that the initialization cannot correct for this.
10.zh: 这里考察另一种训练：不用缩放因子重新参数化适配器，只对适配器的初始化做秩校正。我们用秩 4 和 2048 从两方面看。首先完全不用缩放因子，只把矩阵 A 的初始化按 √1 缩放。这时秩 4 和 2048 在初始化处的梯度范数量级相同，但我们观察到秩 2048 的训练困惑度在训练过程中变得不稳定。其次，把矩阵 A 的初始化按 √1 缩放，同时仍用 LoRA 的缩放因子 1 去缩放适配器。这和 LoRA 一样，训练仍然不理想，说明初始化纠正不了这一点。

12.text: A Rank Stabilization Scaling Factor for Fine-Tuning with LoRA
12.zh: 一种用于 LoRA 微调的秩稳定缩放因子

12.text: Since theorem 3.2 made statements about the moments of the activations, we inspected the averaged first two moments of post-adapter pre-LayerNorm activations. We found that both LoRA and rsLoRA seemed to have relatively stable and non-collapsing activations when averaged over all adapters. This could be due a number of things, including: aspects of the transformer’s non-adapter architecture like LayerNorm, the fact that activations in either case have very small moments, or averaging out effects from averaging all activations and layers. We do note however that the higher ranks (512, 2048) for rsLoRA can be observed to level off later in training for both moments, and although we do not examine this aspect further, it may be that this is a consequence of rank-stabilization that is helpful for training with higher ranks.
12.zh: 由于定理 3.2 对激活的矩作了陈述，我们查看了适配器之后、pre-LayerNorm 之前激活的前两阶矩的平均值。把所有适配器平均之后，LoRA 和 rsLoRA 的激活看起来都比较稳定，没有坍缩。这可能有好几个原因，包括：Transformer 里适配器以外的结构，例如 LayerNorm；两种情况下激活的矩都非常小；以及把全部激活和全部层平均之后抹平了差异。不过我们确实注意到，rsLoRA 在较高秩（512、2048）下，两个矩都会在训练后期趋于平缓。我们没有进一步考察这一点，但它可能正是秩稳定带来的结果，而这种结果有助于用更高的秩训练。

12.text: Figure 9. Average activation first and second moments over training. Here we plot the average activation moments with LoRA and rsLoRA. We see that the average moments for both methods look benign and small in magnitute. One does observe a difference with high ranks in rsLoRA, where the for both moments, the increase in magnitute over training steps levels off considerably.
12.zh: 图 9. 训练过程中激活一阶矩和二阶矩的平均值。这里画出 LoRA 和 rsLoRA 的平均激活矩。两种方法的平均矩看起来都没有问题，幅度也很小。高秩的 rsLoRA 确实有所不同：对两个矩而言，幅度随训练步数的上升，到后期都明显变缓。
